g.aria-label: The quay in 1994, fishing boats moored three deep
g.desc: The quay in 1994, fishing boats moored three deep

g.aria-label: No description survives: this photograph reached the paper from its own archive with no caption and no photographer's name, and nobody there can now say who took it. The desk has run it anyway because it is the only picture of the quay from that decade.

g.text: No caption or photographer came with this frame.
